✖️ The global geoeconomic and geopolitical paradigm is critically vulnerable to a natural disaster black swan. This is the most complex risk on the board, and I have finally finished modeling the outcomes in a qualitative format.  

The keyword? The Triple Rift 

(or more formally: the Rodrigues Triple Junction or RTJ)

This is the meeting point of three major tectonic plates in the Indian Ocean. If these plates suddenly accelerated their movement, pressure would be released all over the planet.

1⃣ West Africa would rip open into a new sea, turning deserts into proto-oceans

2⃣ Teletsunamis and megaquakes would reach and likely shutdown the world's 4 major ports (Shanghai, Singapore, Ningbo-Zhoushan, Busan) and Los Angeles/Long Beach (40% of US imports) and Mumbai, Colombo, Jebel Ali (MENA and Africa lose access to many food imports).

3⃣ The Pacific Rim would erupt, triggering chain reactions across volcanic arcs, many dormant with nearly inestimable effects. (Fortunately, I'm here to estimate the inestimable, and we'll get to that shortly)

4⃣ Rifts would split from the midridges of various oceans like cracks in glass, releasing CO2 and various gases -> affecting sealife, fishing patterns, and global weather permanently.

Contrary to popular belief, it wouldn't be the earthquakes or tsunamis that cause the most change, but the volcanos and rifts that generate the worst second and third order effects on the planet. 
The keyword is "Vog."

▪️▪️▪️

The Pacific Rim going off would release tropospheric pollution (ash + smog = "Vog")

1⃣ This Vog would prevent or dramatically increase air travel costs (since the particulate material would damage turbines)

2⃣ Vog would produce a stratospheric sunblocking effect -> lowering the temperature of the planet by 3 degrees cels over a decade

3⃣ Sulfur rain would ruin crops in some areas

4⃣ Localized suffocation in some areas (Co2 density)

5⃣ Contamination of some fresh water sources

6⃣ Static electricity from Vog ash would generate super-lighting storms, flash droughts, and the Vog's glasslike material would block aerial firefighting -> creating the worst fire season ever for many countries

But the subtle concern is much deeper. The Triple Rift event would trigger its own Pacific Rim-like chain reaction -> creating new rifts like branches on trees.

Massive rifting releases fissure eruptions, or curtains of fire -> increasing oceanic temperature at deep levels, and because ice sheets (such as in Greenland & Antarctica) are grounded below sea level, the ice shelves will detach, and glaciers will slide into the ocean and melt -> rapidly raising sea levels because the deep currents near the rifting will eventually carry warm water around all oceans.

Meanwhile, the sunblock smoke effect from the Pacific Rim eruptions result in cooling, disrupting Ag and global food output. 

The surface cools, the sea warms - simultaneously.

▪️▪️▪️

Cost Estimates: 15%~ in current global GDP gone

On a national basis, the worst hit would be:

1⃣ China -> economic crash overnight, long term damage to import/export functionality. Dramatic overhaul of society would be necessary, and political fracture most likely.

2⃣ Japan, Korea, Indonesia, Philippines -> economic crash over several weeks, long-term issues with food abundance. BoJ inflation risk supercharged -> activating Reverse Carry domino risk -> undoing the Eurozone debt scheme and US cost of money management  -> all fiat currency would fall by the end of the year.

3⃣ United States -> era of cheap consumer tech would be over. Western coastline states would collapse from migration and investment outflow. Designer cities would rise (Sovereign vs 15 minutes = see my highlights)

▪️▪️▪️

Such a global reset of trade and consumption behaviors would further accelerate the AI revolution towards invention and replacement of old paradigms and the doubling down on geoeconomic blocks. 

These blocks (when formed by populist nationstates and stablecoins) will become Federations bound together by baskets of commodities, programmable currencies, and shared technological systems and cultural societies.

A disaster like the Triple Rift + the swap out of our modern monetary system (see highlights) will be the perfect instigator to accelerate this shift. So perfect that it seems like a matter of destiny.

Until then, I will see you on the margins. ✖️10
